// diagnostic

E0105

`greet` is defined twice

What

`greet` is defined twice

Why

Every function needs a unique name so calls aren't ambiguous

Fix

rename or remove one of the definitions

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0105: tests/ui/cli_program_command_collision.stderr.

Error [E0105]: method `collide` can't share a name with a field on `Commands`
  --> tests/ui/cli_program_command_collision.jet:4:8
    |
  4 |     fn collide(self) {}
    |        ^^^^^^^
 Why: a type's methods and fields must have different names
 Fix: rename the method or the field
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0105

Error [E1344]: CLI command `collide` collides with another command or root flag
  --> tests/ui/cli_program_command_collision.jet:4:8
    |
  4 |     fn collide(self) {}
    |        ^^^^^^^
 Why: a program struct has one command namespace and one root flag namespace; a word cannot name both.
 Fix: rename the command or the root field so every command word is unique
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1344
